en: A black‑and‑white, vertically oriented postcard with two separate interior photographs stacked one above the other. The upper image shows a formal office or study: a large wooden desk covered with papers and a typewriter, a patterned rug, paneled walls with vertical stripes, tall curtains with geometric designs, an ornate standing clock, and a round side table with upholstered chairs. The lower image depicts a classroom or lecture room with large windows featuring decorative glass, paneled walls and a coffered ceiling. Individual wooden desks with curved side sections fill the room, all facing a teacher's desk at the front, with a wall clock above it. There is a blank white strip at the bottom where caption text would normally be printed, but it appears empty in this reproduction.
